typographie_suggestion.explanation: The main title "DE CHIMIE" exhibits the classic characteristics of the Didone style: a high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed hair-line serifs. This style was highly prevalent in academic and official French printing during the 19th century.
